item.text: The callback interfaces currently only return values and a partial bit for resources; data sources have no way to report provider deferral through the callback path. I’m checking the policy proto surface and the failing test expectations before editing the API shape.

The generated proto already has `GetDataSourceResponse.deferred`; the seeded regression removed propagation at the Go callback layers. Resource deferral also needs to feed the `partial` flag by consulting `ctx.Deferrals()`, not just unknown attribute filters.

I’ve got enough context now. I’m going to update the internal callback API to carry the data-source deferred bit, have the gRPC server return it, and mark resource callback responses partial when matching resource types have deferred instances recorded in the active eval context.
